faq.q: Do you serve tea without milk or sugar?
faq.a: Yes. Every tea can be served plain, and we bring honey or sugar separately on the side.

faq.q: Can I try a tea before buying a pack?
faq.a: Of course. Ask for a small cup of any leaf and we will brew it so you can taste before you buy.
We have several herbal infusions with no caffeine, made from herbs, flowers and spices.

faq.q: Is there seating for a group?
faq.a: We have a long shared table and smaller corners. Message us ahead for a bigger group.

faq.q: Do you sell loose leaf tea to take home?
faq.a: Yes, we pack loose leaf tea by weight and write simple brewing notes on every pack.

cta.title: Ready To Slow Down With A Cup?

about.title: A Quiet Place For Good Tea
paragraphs: {brand} started with a simple idea: tea deserves the same care as any other craft, from the leaf to the cup.
We buy from small growers, brew each pot by hand and keep the room calm so a cup of tea can still be a pause in the day.

testimonials.quote: The masala chai here tastes like it was simmered, not poured from a machine.
I came for a quiet hour and ended up trying three teas I had never heard of.
Good tea, calm music and no rush to leave. Exactly what I wanted.
